title: Literature · Surveys and Introductions
summary: Standalone source-grounded introductions and selected complete narrative treatments of consequential literary works. Period routes also organize extended studies from other packs.
assumed_background: No prior reading; the lectures introduce their characters and settings and discuss endings.
